title: The style of Bix and Trumbauer: melodic, not technical
summary: Asked how Bix and Frank would play today, Norvo says their era valued playing prettily and melodically without showing off technique.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
